name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Shirley Temple
description: Shirley Temple tastes like the drink you ordered before you were old enough to order anything interesting. Fizzy cherry sweetness meets a splash of bright citrus, then gets showered in tiny, colorful crunchy candies for a crackly, candy-coated twist. Beneath all that crunch, two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy bring the juicy cherry-citrus flavor back around.
